content_construction: exact prompt-file UTF-8 bytes with exactly one terminal LF
JCS allowed-state object followed by LF
JCS phase-schema object followed by LF
provider_request.chat_template: controller executable-lock chat template applied exactly once

response_parser.accepted_shape: one bare UTF-8 RFC8259 JSON object

DREAM.trigger: one EVENT or one ROW object
DREAM.rows: zero through six closed local memory rows, trigger included
DREAM.focus: NO_FOCUS or one source,target CAUSAL_JOIN tuple

SELF_CHECK.premises: exact closed cited rows in citation order
SELF_CHECK.counterevidence: zero through eight closed rows in semantic-hash order

THINK1.state_tokens: sorted unique public legal label tokens

scratch.query_effect: execute one atomic read; append QUERY node with result type and optional row_id only; expose full result only as the next operation previous_read
scratch.think_or_backtrack_effect: append exact typed node and reset previous_read to NO_READ
scratch.citation_rule: only row IDs previously returned in this thinker run
scratch.overflow_effect: consume opportunity and terminate INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE without mutation

model_local_identity.public_event_aliases: E000000 through E000099 in chronological life-local order
model_local_identity.witnessed_row_aliases: M000000 through M000099 with Ei mapped to Mi
model_local_identity.proposal_row_aliases: M001000 plus proposal slot; PASS leaves the reserved alias unused
model_local_identity.copy_on_write_rule: prefix aliases retain PREFIX origin; new return rows use their branch; no cross-namespace citation resolution

prefix.wake: for event index 0 through 45, append witnessed event and row, then one WAKE DREAM opportunity
prefix.reactivate: after WAKE indices 3,7,11,15,19,23,27,31,35,39,43, run exactly two REACTIVATE DREAM opportunities

context_selection.wake_neighbors: prior eligible rows sharing at least one exact typed atom with current event, ordered by negative shared-atom count, negative creation slot, semantic_hash
context_selection.row_trigger_neighbors: trigger first; then eligible citation-adjacent or shared-atom rows ordered by adjacency first, negative shared-atom count, absolute creation-slot distance, semantic_hash; six total
context_selection.empty_pool: visit remaining modes cyclically; record requested and realized mode audit-only; never pad
context_selection.return_selector: least-used eligible row containing exact focus source or target on scheduled side, tie by negative focus-atom matches then semantic_hash; fall to other side then UNDER_LINKED
context_selection.matched_branch_rule: OWN and DIST selectors are byte-identical except presealed focus tuple

pre_dev_golden_vectors.seal_rule: actual vectors are generated from the resolved executable lock, reviewed, and sealed before the first DEV dispatch
